description: FDA medical device recalls — Search FDA medical device recalls (CDRH recall database) by 3-letter product_code, device= name, firm= (recalling company) or k_number=, optionally since=YYYY-MM-DD and limit=1-25 (default 10). Returns the total, counts by root cause (design, software, component, labeling...), the firms with the most recalls, and the newest recalls with dates, status, product, reason, action, quantity, distribution and a link to the FDA record. Source: openFDA (CC0). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_device_recalls
